# Original September 8 Spin custody

This reserved successor adds exactly five original September 8 Spins to the
existing eight-event fee custody owner. They hold 11.52 in fees and 96 in prizes.
Each has one original aggregate fee and three paid contributors. Raw-source count
and recognized-contributor count are deliberately different.

The private original proof binds original charges, both reserve cash legs, and
immutable scope published before entry. It does not supply missing earning terms.
Player closure must use the existing payer with G8's immutable original standings
witness, compared as a whole JSON object under cash `original_standings`.
The original three paid contributors remain eligible for later canonical capture
only when original terms are actually available. No current terms are substituted.

`originals.json` is a lossless PostgreSQL JSON export. Preserve its numeric tokens
and exact bytes. The local support accounts are synthetic; original ranks,
funding, fees and scope are retained. A later isolated restoration of explicitly
synthetic earning agreements verifies the continuation mechanism and does not
claim those agreements ever existed in production.

The native phase is part of the maintained full-schema accounting runner:
`test-full-weekly-accounting-activation.sh --sep8-spin-custody-only`.
It installs the separately qualified eight-event predecessor without repeating
those eight behavior assertions. The new phase must exercise the actual joined
standings, payer, custody and original-capture path, then the maintained engine
decoder. Its success remains distinct from protected checks, installation,
production payment and live verification. MTT owns production operations.

The installed composition is the qualified eight-event custody predecessor,
the actual Breakfast original-witness migration, the five-event fee custody
successor, then the five-event original standings migration. The core standings
SQL is composition input, not a separate installer. The first completion enters
`fn_complete_sep8_spin_original_standings` with immutable expected history and an
operation UUID. The existing canonical terminal remains the only payer.

The phase verifies missing original authority, altered ranks/candidate/manager,
later authority, API privileges, exact replay, competing operations, private
witness rollback and immutability, and the complete original capture continuation.
Five unresolved and five recognized actual receipts reach the maintained engine
decoder. Captured schema additions preserve installed constraints, triggers and
access; no financial owner is replaced by a fixture stub.
